_comment: Pre-Luclin race ID to model code mappings for EverQuest Titanium client
_notes: Updated with s3d_file locations verified against s3d_contents_reference.json; T265 audited every row against an s3d_dump scan of all 419 *_chr*.s3d and the EQE1 texture index (refactor/T265_race_models_audit.md). T304 Leg 2 added the "color" column (#AARRGGBB placeholder-cube tint, used only when no model could be built for the race, T213). THOSE COLOUR VALUES ARE INVENTED, not sourced from EverQuest data: Will ruled on 2026-08-28 that inventing them is acceptable and the bar is "plausible and distinguishable". They are keyed on each row's own name, never on the pre-JSON race numbering.

17.name: Golem
17.note: T265: code was GOM, which befallen_chr.s3d (the s3d_file) does not hold -- GOM is the Velious/PoP golem in 9 archives (kael, skyshrine, sleeper, ...), GOL the classic golem in 43 (befallen, cauldron, unrest, ...). Race 17 spawns classic; GOL matches the archive.

35.name: Eel
35.note: T265: eqemu Race::GiantEel (GetRaceIDName: Eel) had no row. EEL_HS_DEF is in eel_chr.s3d (the client's hole/paw/tak* _chr.txt lists name eel_chr); code taken from the model name, not from a live spawn.

72.name: Ship
72.note: T265: s3d_file was timorous_chr.s3d, which holds LAUNCH/LAUNCHM (the Timorous Deep launches) and no SHIP. SHIP_ACTORDEF is a non-skeletal object model.

114.name: Ghost Ship
114.note: T265: eqemu Race::GhostShip had no row. GSP_ACTORDEF is in oot_chr.s3d and oot_chr2.s3d (non-skeletal object model); code taken from the model name, not from a live spawn. Scale copied from race 72 Ship.

141.name: Boat
141.note: T265: eqemu Race::Boat had no row. BOAT_ACTORDEF is in global_chr.s3d (non-skeletal object model); code taken from the model name, not from a live spawn. Scale copied from race 72 Ship.

240.name: Teleport Man
240.alias_reason: Race 240 (eqemu Race::TeleportMan) has no TPM/TPF mesh in any of the client's 419 *_chr archives; it is an invisible teleport trigger NPC, so it renders with race 127's IVM (Invisible Man) model instead of a placeholder cube. T265.

330.name: Froglok
330.note: T265: FRM_HS_DEF and FRF_HS_DEF exist in exactly one archive, globalpcfroglok_chr.s3d. globalfroglok_chr.s3d holds FRG (the monster froglok) only. T274: this is the PLAYABLE froglok model, distinct from row 26 (FRO, the monster froglok); that disambiguation lives here and NOT in name, because name is the display string /who and /consider print and Titanium prints "Froglok" for both.

415.name: Rat
415.alias_reason: Race 415 (eqemu Race::Rat) postdates Titanium, which ships no distinct model for it -- every one of the client's 209 model codes is already claimed by another race. It is the same creature as race 36, so it renders with race 36's RAT model instead of a placeholder cube. T213.

457.name: Gnomework
457.alias_reason: Race 457 (eqemu Race::Gnomework) postdates Titanium, which ships no distinct model for it. It is a clockwork gnome, so it renders with race 88's CLM/CLF model instead of a placeholder cube. Neuter (gender 2) resolves to the base code via getGenderedRaceCode. T213.
